title: UUID Intra-File Duplicates
description: Metadata-integrity check — UUIDs assigned twice within a single file (export defect, typically caused by copy/paste with old FileMaker versions). Since UUID healing (schema 1.19.0) the importer keeps EVERY occurrence: the twin with the smallest internal id keeps the source UUID, the others receive a deterministic replacement UUID (census mapping in Healed_UUID). This dashboard lists the healed occurrences with plaintext context; 'absorbed' rows remain only for double serialization, FM_UUID_HEAL=0 runs and pre-healing databases.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A UUID assigned to two objects inside one file is a source defect of the FileMaker export. Since schema 1.19.0 FM-Lab heals the collision: both objects exist in the catalog (one under a deterministic replacement UUID), incoming references are distributed via the internal FileMaker ids, and the census keeps the original↔replacement mapping. The source defect itself persists — UUID-keyed external tooling and fmp:// URLs still work on ambiguous identities in the source file.
rule.remediation: The catalog is complete despite the defect (healed twins carry replacement UUIDs). A source-side fix still requires manual work in FileMaker: use the plaintext columns (container, position, decoded text) to locate both objects and recreate one of them. Claris' repair mode assigns entirely new UUIDs and breaks external references.
